name: Carries Crypto Provider
description: This code carries this cryptographic implementation: the library is the provider (the self-built OpenSSL FIPS module), the package or program embeds it (a Go binary's crypto/tls, a Rust crate's aws-lc), or it routes its cryptography through it (cryptography to the system OpenSSL). The crypto_provider's own boundary says whether that is acceptable. Sources are software artifacts only; a key or certificate is never an endpoint, and the edge carries no properties.
